paite: Huchi in gitlouhna tengteng, khemna tengteng, lepchiahna tengteng, hazatna tengteng, gensiatna tengteng tawpsan unla,
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

paite: naungek suak thakte bang in khalam nawitui, bangmah hel louh lunggulh un; huai a na khantheihna ding un:
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

paite: Toupa mihehpih theitak ahi chih na chep tak ngal uleh.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

paite: Amah suang hing, mihingte deih louh, Pathian theih a bel tel leh manpha ahi.
heading: Suang Hing Leh Nam Siangthou
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

paite: Amah kiang a hong pai in, noute ngei leng suang hingte bang in Jesu Khrist ziak a Pathian kipah lam kithoihna lan ding a siampu siangthou hi ding in khalam inn ah leptouh in na om uhi.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Laisiangthou ah: "Ngai un, Zion ah aning a suang kiphamohpen tel a om leh manphatak ka lem hi; amah gingtate azahlak kei ding uh," chih atuang hi.
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

paite: Nou agingtate a ding in huai manphapi ahi, agingtaloute a ding in bel; "Inn lamte suang deih louhpen, huai mah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita hi."
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

paite: Huan "Pukna suang leh dalna suangpi ahi. Thu kigente azuih louh ziak un akisuipuk ua; huchibang ding a sehsa ahi him uhi."
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

paite: Himahleh mial a kipan pawt a, vak lamdangtak a lut ding a nou hon sampa hoihna na muhsak theihna ding un, nou zaw chitel, kumpi siampu, nam siangthou, Pathian mite na hi uhi;
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

paite: Nidanglai in nam himhim na hi kei ua; tu in zaw Pathian namte na hita uh; nidanglai in zahngaihna na mu kei ua, tu in zaw zahngaihna na muta uhi.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

paite: Deihtakte aw, mikhual leh khualzin na hih ziak un kha dou nakpa taksa utnate tawpsan ding in nou ka hon ngen hi.
heading: Pathian Sikhate Thunuailutna
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

paite: Zentelte lak a na tatdan uh kilawmtak hi hen, huchi in thil hihkhial a, ahon gensiat chiang un leng na thil hoih hih amuhte uh ziak in veh a a-om chiang un Pathian apahtawi thei ding uhi.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

paite: Toupa ziak in mihing dan bawl peuhmah ah lut un; thuneihna tawi kumpipa kiang ah hiam,
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

paite: thil hihkhialte tung a thuk ding leh thil hoih hihte phat ding a kumpipa'n aseh gam ukpate thunuai ah lut un.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

paite: Hiai Pathian deihlam ahi, mihaite haina thil hoih hih in na hihdai thei ding uhi.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

paite: Noplen na hi ua, himahleh na noplenna uh khelhna khuhna ding a zang lou in Pathian sikha a omna ding in zang zaw un.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

paite: Mi tengteng zahtak un. Ki-unauna it un. Pathian laudan siam un. Kumpipa pahtawi un.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

paite: Sikhate aw, mihoih leh minunnemte lak kia hilou in migiloute lak ah leng laudan siam in nou hon heute thuthu in om un.
heading: Sikhate'n Khrist Etton Ding
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

paite: Mi'n Pathian theihna ziak in thuak louh ding thuak a lungkhamna athuak teiteileh huai pen Pathian pahtak lam ahi.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

paite: Nou na thilhihkhelh ziak ua vuak na thuak un, kuhkaltak in thuak mah le uchin phatna bang na loh ua? Himahleh na thil hoih hih ziak ua na thuak ua, kuhkaltak a na thuak teitei ualeh, hiai pen Pathian kipah lam ahi.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

paite: Khrist in leng nou ahon thuaksak ziak in, huai bang hih ding a sap na hi uhi; akhap a na zuihna ding un zuih ding ahon nutsiat ahi.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

paite: "Ama'n thil ahihkhial kei a, akam ah khemna leng a-om sam kei."
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

paite: Enghou a a-om lai in, a-enghou thuk kei a, athuak lai in avau kei hi; diktattak a ngaihtuahpa kiang ah akipe zaw hi.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

paite: Khelhna lam a si khin, adiktatna lam a i hintheihna ding in amah mah in tua sing ah asa in i khelhnate apua hi; avuakna golhte ah hihdam in na omta uhi.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

paite: Belam mang bang in na mang ua, tu'n zaw nou hon chingpa leh heutupa kiang ah na kik nawnta uhi.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
